title: Looking for a Sandwich
text_path: Closed Doors/02 - Looking for a Sandwich.txt
audio_path: Closed Doors/audio/02 - Looking for a Sandwich.mp3

transcript_segments.text: someone said my words were salad which is fair
there were leaves there were layers there was dressing involved
but i couldn't help thinking maybe you were just looking for a sandwich
i spent weeks folding feelings into strange little shapes
making paper birds out of things i couldn't say then
someone came with the fork in their fist like
hey this is confusing where's the plate
i said the plate is implied they said that's the problem
i said the problem is hunger dressed up as logic
i wrote the moon has a bruise where the morning got in
they said what does that mean
i said it means i was lonely
they said why not say that
i said because i was lonely
some people build houses some people build tents
some leave notes in bottles then complain about rent
me i build mazes with the door at the start
then get offended when nobody studies the walls and calls it art
maybe i hid too well maybe i dressed the wound too fine
maybe i made a meal then blamed you for wanting a sign
if you see only salad maybe you were looking for a sandwich
maybe i was speaking in storms when you only packed a blanket
if you couldn't find the meaning maybe i buried it too deep
but don't call it empty just because it made you reach
still could have used less parsley
i used to think being understood meant being reduced
like if i gave you the key then the room would be used
like someone would walk through my head with muddy shoes
point at the curtains and say bit much don't you think
and maybe it is maybe i put chandeliers in sheds
maybe i describe a headache like a cathedral arguing with bees
maybe i hid a whole confession in a slice of cake and called it liberation
but listen when you grow up explaining your face
your tone your hands or silence your reasons for standing too close
then too far away to know where anyone can reach
you learn that plain speech is not always safer
sometimes plain speech is a window sometimes a metaphor is curtains
sometimes curtains are the only thing between you and everyone looking in like they paid for a tour
so yes i served you leaves bitter ones strange ones a few i should have washed
but there was a pulse underneath there was a table there was a chair pulled out
there was me trying badly to invite you somewhere
if you's the only salad maybe you were looking for a sandwich
maybe i was speaking in storms when you only packed a blanket
if you couldn't find the meaning maybe i buried it too deep
but don't call it empty just because it made you reach
and i get it not every locked door is profound
sometimes it's just a locked door
not every strange phrase is a treasure chest
sometimes it's just me panicking attractively
sometimes the truth looks cold all apart so i overdress it and call it art
sometimes i leave the door half open so the room can change with who walks in
if i name every shadow too clearly it stops belonging to anyone but me
that's annoying also useful
you came looking for lunch and found a forest
i came looking for praise and found a mirror wearing your disappointed face
maybe the next one gets a signpost maybe the next one gets bread
maybe the next time i say grief without dressing it up as weather in my head
maybe i leave room for the listener without handing them a map
maybe i stop calling every open handed trap but i won't flatten the hills just to make the walk polite
i won't drain all the colors so the water looks right
there's a place between them since an over explained between
look how deep i am and please feel my pain
i'm trying to find it badly with herbs
so if the line feels crooked maybe sit with the bend
if the meaning comes late maybe wait for the end
and if you still see salad well fair enough friend
but i was feeding something
i couldn't name them
if you see only salad maybe you were looking for a sandwich
maybe i was speaking in storms when you only packed a blanket
if you couldn't find the meaning maybe i buried it too deep
but don't call it empty just because it made you reach
if you see only salad maybe i'll bring bread next time
but i won't stop growing strange things in the garden of my mind
so no hard feelings
you want it simple
i want it seen
somewhere between the lettuce and the longing
we were both a little hungry
